identities.labelNature: Name explicitly mentioned in editorial reporting; not a guessed official sign
identities.datePrecision: Article publication, not an individual ride opening date
identities.result: Named presence in 2017 is supported; physical design and relation to the 43 existing items remain unknown.
identities.reason: The article lists it separately from sack racing, pedal karts, swing chairs, zip lines, baby zone and inflatable castles. Its three retained photographs show founders in a train, hammocks/meadow, and a swing-chair montage. No named photograph of Twister was found.
identities.safeAction: Keep the sourced 2017 mention and unresolved mapping; do not invent dimensions, rules, manufacturer, physical model, alias or dates.

identities.labelNature: Visual description, not an official attraction name
identities.dateEvidence: June 2020 visitor review retained in the existing manifest; no exact capture day inferred
identities.observed: Large orange octopus head and tentacles over pink supports, broad pale-blue/turquoise sloping inflatable faces, orange strip with climbing holds. Located behind the pedal-kart course in the photograph; no name sign legible.
identities.result: Physical presence is proven. Official name and potential former/replacement identity are not proven.
identities.comparison: The 2025 and 2026 cartographic Baby Volcan has palms, La Boule has a suspended-ball frame, and Phare des Pirates has a pirate tower. These different depicted appearances do not establish a retrospective alias or exclude undocumented replacement/retheming.
identities.safeAction: Keep the existing park-owned 2020 photo and neutral caption. Do not relink it to Baby Volcan, Phare des Pirates or another item without direct evidence.

identities.labelNature: Visual description, not an official attraction name
identities.sourceAuthor: Renard60La for the Tripadvisor 2020 views; tourism credit preserved separately
identities.dateEvidence: 2020 visitor series; tourism photograph itself undated
identities.observed: Inflatable yellow/orange crenellated towers and brick-like wall outlines. A wider 2020 view (local tripadvisor-1b789483) shows it simultaneously with the orange octopus, confirming they are separate structures. No name sign legible.
identities.result: Physical presence is proven. Official name and mapping to an existing item are not proven.
identities.comparison: The undated photographic map and 2025/2026 maps have named Saloon, Baby Pirate, Baby Volcan, Le Gorille, Parcours Extrême and other inflatables, but no demonstrable match to this yellow castle. Similar category is insufficient for an alias.
identities.safeAction: Keep as an unresolved historical identity; no duplicate attraction creation or arbitrary relinking.
